description.default: List overdue unpaid invoices in Brillienta CRM with customer, outstanding amount and days overdue. Use for prompts such as 'Overdue invoices', 'Who owes us money?' or 'Invoices more than 30 days overdue for Contoso'. Pass minDaysOverdue, accountName and onlyMine only when the user states them. This tool never sends reminders or changes invoices.
